YOU'RE DEAD

VANDERLYN AVENUE

Gowan Heights, Brooklyn. October 1992. You grew up in the room over Dutch's Hardware on Vanderlyn Avenue. Your father drove the B9 bus; nobody in your family was ever "with" anybody. You have sixty dollars, a leather jacket, and nothing to do on a Saturday. Everybody on the avenue knows who the real people are: the men at Fellaini's Caffè, and Vinnie "Abatz" Coloro, who drinks at The Anchor and is always looking for kids with nerve. Press I any time for How to play.

WASD move · Space jump · mouse look (click the street) · click attack · R reload · E talk · 1-5 equip, or choose in dialogue · wheel cycles items · Tab ledger · I how to play · M city map (wheel zoom, drag to pan) · T skip 3 hours · Shift sprint · Q hail a cab · E get in / hotwire / out of cars · Witnesses call the cops: break line of sight to lose them · C car camera · H horn · G graphics quality · V mute · P or Esc pause / save
